home.heroSubtitle: Master NEB Grade 11 & 12 Physics. Solve important questions, take daily quiz tests, and ace your IOE (Engineering) & IOM (Medical) entrance tests.
home.feature1Desc: Seamlessly toggle between English and Nepali Devanagari translation for all topics, equations, and solutions.
home.feature2Desc: Specially curated mock entrance series conforming to IOE and MEC standards with marking guidelines.
home.feature3Desc: Chapterwise long questions, short conceptual questions, and solved numerical problems targeting NEB board exams.
home.feature4Desc: Continuous updates based on recent syllabi, student feedback, and custom requests submitted directly to us.

quiz.dailyQuizDesc: Sharpen your physics concept every day. 10 questions, 60 seconds per question with explanations.
quiz.question: Question
quiz.tryAgainTomorrow: Come back tomorrow for a new set of questions!

mock.title: Mock Entrance Hub
mock.engineeringDesc: 45 Minutes, 25 Questions. 10 questions (1 mark each) + 15 questions (2 marks each) = 40 total marks. Negative marking rate is 10%.
mock.medicalDesc: 45 Minutes, 50 Questions. 1 mark each = 50 total marks. Negative marking rate is 25% (-0.25 marks per incorrect answer).

feedback.title: Feedback and Support
feedback.description: Have you noticed any malfunction on our website? Report it immediately using our feedback form or reach out to us on our Facebook page.
feedback.googleFormText: Submit your report below. If the embedded form doesn't load, make sure you are online.
feedback.catBugDesc: Buttons not working, page loading issues, UI errors
feedback.catContentDesc: Formula mistakes, incorrect answer key, grammar typos
feedback.catSuggestionDesc: Specific chapters or custom mock tests you'd like to see
feedback.messengerDesc: Send a direct message on Facebook for rapid developer support.
feedback.faq1q: When is the daily quiz updated?
feedback.faq1a: Our daily quiz rotates automatically every midnight local time based on a deterministic rotation pool.
feedback.faq2q: Does this cover the latest syllabus?
feedback.faq2a: Yes! All chapters, numericals, and mock entrance exams match the newest CDC/NEB directives.
feedback.faq3a: Yes. Please use the feedback form or message us directly on our Facebook page 'Physics Insight'.

about.title: About Physics Insight
about.missionDesc: Physics Insight started as a Facebook educational page to simplify physics concepts for Nepali +2 students. This platform expands that goal by offering comprehensive interactive tools, bilingual study notes, and simulation mock tests to help students excel in board papers and entrance exams.
